name: ZIPZAX
tagline: 475+ free online tools for PDFs, images, text, developers and AI writing
description: ZIPZAX is a growing collection of 475+ free online tools in one place: PDF tools like merge, split and compress, image converters and editors, video and audio utilities, developer helpers, and 57 free AI tools for writing, summarizing, rewriting and paraphrasing. Built by a small self-funded team in Lisbon, Portugal to make everyday tasks quicker.
